summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Distributor filter + Customer multi-select autocomplete on /customer-invoice-overview. All tasks pass: filter bar shows both comboboxes; distributor 'Brian' -> 13/24, 'Unassigned' -> 7/24, clear -> 24/24; sub-line correctly shows distributor name (e.g. Brian). Multi-select stays open while adding multiple customers, chips count shows 2, table filters to exactly 2 rows, selected options carry data-selected='true' with filled checkbox. Combined: distributor Brian narrows customer options to exactly 13, and switching the distributor resets the customer selection (customers-count element disappears). 'Clear filters' appears when any filter is active and resets all four (distributor, customers, search, hide-zero). Regression: search 'Toopa' -> 1/24, search-clear works, month headers with 'current' badge on Sep 2026 present, Excel export button visible/enabled; no React console errors (only unrelated 401s on unrelated resources before login).
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerInvoiceOverview.jsx: customerOptions correctly re-scopes to the selected distributor and setDistributor also clears customers[] – matches spec.
MultiSearchCombobox keeps popover open on toggle (onSelect just toggles, doesn't close) – matches spec (can select multiple in one open).
SearchCombobox stopPropagation on the inline Clear (pointerdown+click) is correct so distributor-clear doesn't reopen the popover.
